title: Ex vivo mouse hematopoietic stem cell expansion using polyvinyl alcohol
protocol: Make up a 100 mg/ml stock of PVA in DI water in a heatproof glass bottle and autoclaving to dissolve.
Confirm PVA is completely dissolved visually after autoclaving.
Stock the PVA solution at 4°C.
Dissolve SCF cytokine at 1:1000 stocks in F12 media (10 ug/ml).
Dissolve TPO cytokines at 1:1000 stocks in F12 media (100 ug/ml).
Aliquot and stock the dissolved SCF and TPO solutions at -20°C or -80°C.
Prepare fresh HSC media for each use by mixing F12 media with 10mM HEPES, 1X P/S/G, 1X ITSX, 1 mg/ml PVA, 100 ng/ml TPO, and 10 ng/ml SCF.
Pre-warm the prepared HSC media to 37°C before use.
Mix the viscous PVA solution slowly while preparing F12 media.
Invert the mixed media well to ensure thorough mixing.
Transfer 200 μl of HSC media into each desired 96-well plate well for direct sorting.
Fill remaining plate wells with PBS.
Directly sort HSCs by FACS into 96-well plate wells.
Transfer sorted HSCs immediately to a tissue culture incubator set to 37°C with 5% CO₂ and 20% O₂.
Avoid disturbing the cultures where possible, although cells can be visually evaluated by light microscopy.
Perform media changes every 2-3 days after the first 5-6 days of culture.
Prepare fresh HSC media as needed before initiating media changes.
Gently remove all media from the well using a pipette to avoid disturbing the cells attached to the well bottom.
Add 200 μl of pre-warmed media down the well gently. Avoid removing media from too many wells at one time to prevent cells from drying out.
Transfer back to the tissue culture incubator after media changes.
Repeat media changes every 2-3 days throughout the culture.
Passage cells into 3x 96-well plate wells or 1 x 24-well plate well when they reach ~90% confluency.
Dissociate attached cells by gently pipetting the media over the plate bottom when expanding cultures.
Use cells for in vitro analysis at any time during culture.
Perform cell counting on HSC cultures without repeatedly mixing them.
Dissociate attached cells by gently pipetting the media over the plate bottom before counting.
Transfer 10 μl of the culture to a tube and mix with 1:1 Trypan Blue for counting using a hemocytometer.
Alternatively, use an automated cell counter following the manufacturer’s instructions.
Stain cells with Sca1, cKit, and Lineage antibodies after titration.
Dissociate attached cells by gently pipetting media over the plate bottom.
Transfer dissociated cells to a tube and spin down at 1500 rpm (440 g) for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cells in PBS containing a lineage antibody cocktail (containing Biotin-CD4, Biotin-CD8, Biotin-CD45RA/B220, Biotin-Ter119, Biotin-Ly6G/Ly6C, Biotin-CD127, Biotin-FceR1).
Stain cells at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Wash cells with at least 10 volumes of PBS and spin down.
Resuspend cells in PBS containing PE-Sca1, APC-cKit, Streptavidin-APC/eFluor780 antibodies.
Stain cells at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Wash cells with at least 10X volume of PBS and spin down.
Resuspend cells in ~200 ul PBS containing 1X PI.
Analyze samples on a FACS machine/flow cytometer.
Use unstained and single stained samples as controls.
Quantify the frequency of Kit⁺Sca1⁺Lineage⁻ live cell population.
